rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the main entrance gate of a house or building.

example.english: Please wait for me at the main gate.
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 hai2 daai6 mun4 dang2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a metal or barred house gate and for a movable barrier such as one at a railway crossing.

example.english: The gate at home always needs to be locked securely.
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 go3 zaap6 sing4 jat6 jiu3 so2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for a doorway or entrance opening in a wall or fence rather than for the barrier itself.

example.english: The car is blocking the gate.
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 sak1 zyu6 zo2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this for an airport boarding gate where passengers wait to board or leave the aircraft.

example.english: We’re waiting at the gate to board.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zaap6 hau2 dang2 gan2 soeng5 gei1
